title: 6.8.1 Video — Joints in moshion
description: Three joint types in five minutes: a distance joint keeps two sprites a fixed length apart, a hinge lets one pivot around another, and a slider rides a track. You don't need to master all three — just watch and pick the one that fits your game.
videoFallback: Teacher-recorded walkthrough. Ask your teacher for the YouTube link, or open the classroom slide deck for the live demo.
